texts: For me it's mostly about the programme.
I'd like to see more structure, like regular workshops on set topics.
Every month there could be, say, a beginners' session on electronics, one on video, one on 3D printing.
Right now it feels a bit random what's on.
I'd actually go to more things if there was a schedule I could plan around.
As a freelancer it's too expensive for me, honestly.
I pay almost as much as I would for a co-working desk and I use it maybe once a week.
A cheaper plan for occasional users would make sense.
I know the lab has costs, I'm not saying it should be free.
But yeah, a pay-per-visit option or something like that.
